generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Contractor must have successfully completed similar painting works at a height of minimum 20 metres

Contractor must have successfully completed Industrial painting/chimney painting/bituminous paints on industrial exhaust systems.High-altitude/rope access structural painting jobs in the past 5 years i.e Value Rs.02 Lakhs from the period of 2021-22 to 2025-26
The bidder must have achieved a minimum financial turnover of not less than Rs. 8 Lakhs in at least 2 out of the 5 financial years from 2021-22 to 2025-26.

itemList.description: Painting work for the Boiler chimney with ladder(bottom dia -1.5m,top dia-0.75m and height -32m). Removing the old paint from steel or other metal surface (inner and outer)Even. surfaces must be perfectly clean and free of rust and grease, achieved through abrasive blasting . No Thinner Required: thinning should generally be avoided, only specified "slow thinner" or "retarder", may be used sparingly if applied via spray.(Only add a small amount of thinner, generally between 5% to 10% of the paint volume,manufacturers authorisation is required)*1. Heat Resistant Primer: (a)Type: Inorganic Ethyl Zinc Silicate or Silicone Zinc Primer. (b)Temperature Resistance: Dry heat up to 400 degree celcius.(c) DFT (Dry Film Thickness): 25 - 30 microns per coat *2. Heat Resistant Paint (Topcoat): (a) Type: Single-pack, Silicone Resin-based Aluminium Paint. (b) Temperature Resistance: Dry continuous heat up to 400 degree celcius (c)Finish: Bright, smooth, metallic lustrous aluminium.(d) DFT (Dry Film Thickness): 25 - 30 microns per coat. (e) Number of Paint coats-02. (f) Brand & Quality:  Asian Paints for its high-performance metallic formulation that prevents rust and discoloration on hot surfaces to be used Step-by-Step Duration Breakdown:(a)Primer Coat: Apply one coat of heat-resistant zinc or silicone primer, waiting a full 24 hours before applying the next coat (b) First Paint Coat: Apply the first coat of heat-resistant paint and allow 24 hours before applying the next coat."(c)Second Paint Coat: Apply the second coat of heat-resistant paint to allow the underlying coat to reach a "hard dry" state(d)Heat Curing:Heat must be applied to high-temperature paints to fully cure the resins through polymerization, ensuring long-term durability.Cost of all materials, labour, Scaffolding Arrangement , safety equipments all other charges complete as per specifications and work to be carried out as per directions of Engineer-in charge.The contractor must submit a 5-year warranty for the chimney painting work. This warranty must be provided on their official letterhead and include their official seal and signature at the time of bill submission. The cost is Exclusive of GST.
